snippet.title: DuneCrawl - Release Trailer | PS5 Games
snippet.description:
https://store.playstation.com/concept/10018318

DuneCarwl is coming to PS5 on October 19th, 2026 with Cross-Play Support.

DuneCrawl is an open world action-adventure game, where you take to the sandy seas atop a gigantic crustacean festooned with black powder cannons. Play as a solo Crab Keeper, or with a crew of up to three other friends in local and online coop.

#ps5 #ps5games
